tasks.title: Deploy UI
tasks.description: Build Vue UI with Vite and deploy to public/

tasks.title: Deploy to 8449 (Prod)
tasks.description: Build Vue UI to public/, then restart webgit.service (systemd, port 8449) so the live site at git.ms.mdevs.uk loads the new code
tasks.command: bash scripts/deploy.sh && sudo systemctl restart webgit.service

tasks.title: Restart Dev Server (kill + start)
tasks.description: Kill existing process on port 3000, then start dev server with file watching
tasks.command: lsof -ti:3000 | xargs -r kill -9 && npm run dev

tasks.title: Test Graph Algorithm
tasks.description: Run graph algorithm unit tests (routeLanes) and generate visual demo HTML. Re-runs both when core algorithm changes.

tasks.title: Test Graph Algorithm (watch)
tasks.description: Run graph tests and regenerate demo HTML, then watch for file changes and re-run automatically.
